[LOPQ.3.2] **Declared adapter operations.** Any `service` or builtin whose
signature names the opaque type may take or return it; the type system enforces
argument and return matching.

A `service` takes its arguments as `kwarg` declarations and names a **response
schema** rather than a scalar return ([LGRA] `response_decl`), so an opaque
return type appears as a slot on that schema.
